videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences capturing the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Doosan Robotics and NVIDIA collaboration isn't new - Doosan Vice Chairman visited NVIDIA HQ last year, and in April, Madison Huang (key NVIDIA figure for robotics) visited Doosan Tower to discuss Physical AI and humanoid robot development cooperation.
2. At Computex 2026 in Taiwan, Jensen Huang mentioned various platforms including robots, and there's speculation he might throw the first pitch at a Doosan Bears baseball game in Seoul (June 5-7), which would symbolize the NVIDIA-Doosan partnership.
3. Despite no visible humanoid robot release or concrete contract yet, Doan Robotics has strong backing from Doosan Group with immediate testing/application sites in nuclear power, heavy industry, construction machinery, logistics, etc.
4. This infrastructure makes Doosan Robotics valuable in the global market and NVIDIA ecosystem, even though they need to be cautious as they haven't shown concrete results yet.
